item.tib: zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las gter 'byung dbyar gyi rnga gsang
item.coloph: rgyal bstan rab mdzes rgyal mtshan cher/ srid rtser sgreng ba'i spob pa can/ rigs sngags 'chang ba'i rnal 'byor ba/ o rgyan bde chen gling pa yi (yis/)smin grol gdan sa gnyis par brtsams / dge ba nyin byed dang po des/ 'gro ba'i mun pa rab gsal (bsal) nas/ skal ldan snang ba rgyas par shog/
